release_findings: Public training code is for AnimateDiff, not the paper's VideoCrafter1/LVDM tables.
Each training shell script overwrites its eight-GPU setting with a one-GPU debug setting.
Released configs specify 1000000 steps rather than the paper's 50000/20000/20000 schedule.
Released CMCM config uses per-device batch 1 and accumulation 4 and does not instantiate the paper's global batch 128 as shipped.
The exact RealEstate10K captions/list and 243000-video WebVid selection are absent.
motion_seg_list_v2.txt and all derived ParticleSfM trajectories are absent.
Paper evaluation manifests and metric implementations are absent.
required_before_training: A legally usable raw-media corpus with source URLs, licenses, hashes and retained media.
A complete training-sample manifest for every RealEstate10K and WebVid clip.
Reproducible BLIP2 caption and ParticleSfM trajectory-generation environments.
An explicitly reconstructed VideoCrafter1/LVDM training program matching 50000/20000/20000 steps and batch 128.
A frozen public evaluation protocol distinct from any unavailable paper benchmark.
One-batch decode, conditioning, forward/backward, optimizer, checkpoint and resume smokes.
